title: Registry API version disclosed (Docker-Distribution-Api-Version header)
description: The response advertises the Docker registry API version in Docker-Distribution-Api-Version. The header confirms that a registry endpoint is publicly reachable and tells a reader which API surface to expect, which is the first step in enumerating images and tags.
remediation: Keep the registry behind authentication and network policy rather than on a public host, and strip the version header at the edge when the registry must face the internet.
limitation: One header value. The rule reports the advertised registry version; it does not test whether the registry allows anonymous pulls.
